description: The user requested improvements to a Vue.js component to ensure it is reactive and maintains scroll position when content updates. The VueCodeHighlighter component should add new content without resetting the user's scroll position. The revised code now includes a mechanism to save the scroll position and restore it after content updates by storing `prevScrollTop` and using this value in a watcher for the `code` property. The setup script remains unchanged, adhering to the project's requirements to use TailwindCSS and DaisyUI components and avoid CSS usage within the component.
